title: Tak - The Great Juju Challenge
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Tak and Lok; health
Tak and Lok compete in the Juju challenge courses; both are controlled as a team
Difficulty is picked per save: "good for beginners", "a great challenge" or "seasoned players only"

Team-up moves with Lok
Lok and Tak have different abilities: Lok is strong (pushing, breaking), Tak uses juju magic
Team moves (throwing a partner, bouncing) reach higher routes

Juju challenge events
Challenge types named in the game include: Run! Run! Run!, Bounce to the Top!, Take 'Em Out!, Reach for the Stars!, Get Skunked!, Fly, Tak Fly! and a lock-picking "Lok the Locksmith" round
Each challenge has its own goal shown at the start: read it, the goal changes the scoring

Challenge courses
Courses are grouped by challenge type; finishing them opens the next set

Juju items
Juju blessings are awarded for races and challenges

rows: SUN and MOON rankings are shown at the end of a challenge

widgets.text:
Challenges won
Earn rankings on every course; harder difficulty asks for faster times
